scenarios.name: real_extension_previous_window_update_guidance
scenarios.title: Diagnose an unchanged released extension through the current Python CLI
scenarios.workflow: Load the released extension -> connect through the current CLI -> compare actual loaded and bundled versions -> request window restore -> preserve unsupported refusal, versions and ordinary reload guidance
scenarios.user_problem: Updating Python must not imply that the user's running Chrome extension supports new window operations.
